findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_read · Private data: base_gas, decode_transaction, verify_receipt, token_metadata, fx_rate, stock_quote, web_read, web_search, secure_random, weather, crypto_price, domain_check, scan_headers_free, scan_headers, token_intel, wallet_risk, github_repo_intel · Public sink: base_gas, decode_transaction, verify_receipt, token_metadata, fx_rate, stock_quote, web_read, web_search, secure_random, weather, crypto_price, domain_check, scan_headers_free, scan_headers, token_intel, wallet_risk, github_repo_intel.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_read · Private data: base_gas, decode_transaction, verify_receipt, token_metadata, fx_rate, stock_quote, web_read, web_search, secure_random, weather, crypto_price, domain_check, scan_headers_free, scan_headers, token_intel, wallet_risk, github_repo_intel · Public sink: base_gas, decode_transaction, verify_receipt, token_metadata, fx_rate, stock_quote, web_read, web_search, secure_random, weather, crypto_price, domain_check, scan_headers_free, scan_headers, token_intel, wallet_risk, github_repo_intel

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
